description: What happened to a campaign, newest first, a page at a time. What people and keys did, with `by`: created, edited (`fields`), steps, leads and mailboxes changed, launched, paused, a lead paused or resumed by hand, a lead sent anyway or taken back. What the campaign did on its own: `paused` with `by` null and its `reason` (the guardrail's `rule` too), `finished` with its lead counts, `waiting_for_leads`, `lead_skipped` (a lead left out: `suppressed`, `not_eligible` for an address it may no longer write to, or `unrenderable` when its step wouldn't render for it), `lead_moved` (a lead's mailbox couldn't send, so it went to another), `lead_replied_elsewhere` (the person answered another campaign, so this lead ended; `campaign` names it) and `copy_dropped` (a Cc or Bcc left out of an email: `suppressed` or `invalid`). A line that would repeat, such as the same lead left out on every pass, is written once a day in the workspace's time zone. Kept 90 days. Each email is on list_sends, not here. Filter with `kinds`: `changes`, `status` or `leads`. Omitted means all; order and duplicates don't matter. Keep the same group set with a cursor.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

kinds.description: History groups to include: changes (edits, steps, mailboxes, leads added or removed, a lead paused or sent anyway, and segment links or sync), status (launch, resume, reopen, both kinds of pause, finish and waiting for leads), leads (a lead skipped or moved, a lead stopped because the person answered another campaign, or a copy dropped). Left out: all history. Send one value, repeat kinds in the URL, or use a JSON array. Empty and unknown groups are refused. Order and duplicates don't matter; keep the same group set when paging with a cursor.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_campaign_log
title: Read a campaign's log
